title: Continuous workload profiler and safe batch parameter annealer
creator: Aisha Martinez
description: Build a continuous workload profiler and an annealer service that proposes, simulates (shadow), and safely applies batching and KV-cache parameter changes. The goal is to reduce per-token cost while maintaining latency SLOs by synthesizing compact workload signatures, detecting microburst patterns, and annealing continuous batch/window/kv parameters with conservative rollouts. The system should produce clear cost delta estimates and automatic rollback triggers tied to production signals.
acceptance_criteria: Profiling agent that fingerprints request shape (seq len distribution, client-id cardinality, microburst index) and exports daily summaries to telemetry
Annealer produces deterministic parameter proposals (batch size, max latency target, kv-window, prefetch horizon) and a cost delta estimate for each proposal
Shadow-simulator can replay 48h of historical traffic with proposals and produce token-cost and p99 latency deltas within ±5% of actuals
Canary rollout automation that applies proposals to a shadowed 1-2% traffic slice for 2 hours, evaluates safety gates, and either promotes or rolls back automatically
Rollback triggers based on user-defined guardrails (p95 latency regressions > 10%, error-rate increase > 0.2%, model-quality signal drop) and an automatic remediation path
Console UI flags to review proposals and an audit log entry for each apply/rollback with links to telemetry and PRs
tasks: Implement lightweight profiling agent (envoy filter + uvloop collector) to capture request metadata
Design compact workload signature schema and store in time-series (Influx/ClickHouse)
Build annealer service with simulated annealing-inspired parameter search and cost model
Integrate shadow-simulator with existing replay infra and batch runtime hooks
Implement safety gate evaluator and canary orchestrator (kubernetes rollout-style)
Add console review UI and audit logging for proposals/changes
Create runbook for failed rollouts and developer-facing rollback diagnostics
rollout_plan: Step 1: Collect 72h of profiles from staging & 48h from production shadow (1 week)
Step 2: Run annealer on sampled cohorts and generate proposals (internal only)
Step 3: Shadow-simulate top-3 proposals against 48h window; pick candidate
Step 4: Canary apply candidate to 1% traffic for 2h; monitor safety gates
Step 5: If gates pass, promote to 10% for 4h; if still green, promote roll-forward to 50% then 100% over 48h
Step 6: If any safety gate trips, auto-rollback to previous config and open incident with diagnostics
